articles.title: Rupee weakens 24 paise to settle at 92.44 against US dollar
articles.excerpt:
The rupee settled 24 paise lower at 92.44 (provisional) against the US dollar on Thursday, facing resistance due to higher crude oil prices and fear of additional US tariffs.

Forex traders said foreign fund inflows favoured the Indian currency, even though crude oil prices reversed easing trend, hovering near the $95-per-barrel level.

They also said the Donald Trump administration's latest proposal to escalate the trade war with major trading partners raised inflation fears.

The US on Wednesday proposed 25 per cent tariffs on imports from India, with a provision to cap them at 17 per cent if the two countries agree to a bilateral trade deal, giving it a slight edge over Asian competitors.
